subject.title: Proposal: accept optional exact-head proof packets as review input

question: Should ClawSweeper adopt one optional fenced `clawsweeper-proof` JSON block in PR descriptions as the v1 exact-head evidence-metadata surface?
rationale: The repository has a concrete freshness gap and the proposed implementation is bounded, but choosing a new contributor-facing structured contract is product intent that source history cannot settle.

options.title: Accept Parser-First Slice
options.body: Approve bounded parsing, live-head comparison, normalized prompt context, and focused fixtures while leaving all proof verdict and mutation behavior unchanged.

options.title: Keep Free-Form Proof
options.body: Retain model inspection of ordinary PR descriptions and decline a structured contributor contract for now.

options.title: Select Another Surface
options.body: Define exact-head evidence metadata through a different existing GitHub or workflow surface before implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept Parser-First Slice
recommendation.body: Approve bounded parsing, live-head comparison, normalized prompt context, and focused fixtures while leaving all proof verdict and mutation behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The current proof schema and most recent proof-policy boundary changes provide the closest direct ownership signal for this input-contract choice.
